scenes.summary: A band of Landbreakers has taken over the only road to the Valley Fort. They are also executing their own people for lack of discipline.

lines.text: So many Landbreakers... They even built a camp.
They're sitting on the only way to the Valley Fort. I think they're here to block reinforcements.
They are blocking our only way. Take them down, Chen.
Please! Don't kill me! Just gimme another——
Our rising clan does not need gutless cowards.
The baws wants warriors. Disciplined warriors. Disobey, and you DIE — like this one!
*Mumbles*. ENEMIES?
THERE! KILL THEM! SHOW THEM THE POWER OF THE CLAN!

scenes.summary: You successfully rendezvous with the Landbreaker specialist named Catello Wulfgard Luppino. You make preparations to repair the devices for controlling the bridge and head to the Valley Fort.

lines.text: A brave one. Impressive. You must be the legendary Endministrator.
⟦key|Catello Wulfgard Luppino⟧. Formally reporting for duty, Endministrator.
That's how Supervisor Perlica usually introduces me. Two words that go straight to the point.
Wulfgard is an Endfield Specialist Tech Division operator. He's an expert in covert combat, solo operations, and ... Landbreaker issues. You can trust his skills.
Listen, Wulfgard, pointing your gun at a fellow Endfielder is never acceptable. Have I made myself clear?
Apologies, Supervisor Perlica. It was an emergency and I failed to notice the Endministrator. It won't happen again.
I will hold you to that. Valley IV is in a state of emergency, and the Crisis Team requires your assistance.
I'm on it. The Bonekrushers have sabotaged the devices for controlling the bridge and severed the power cables.
These raiders only focused on raiding and looting in the past. Such actions are too well thought out. This isn't their style.
Hmm. This control panel's busted... Those LBs might have stripped its parts off.
The power issue is something we can handle. The Automation-Core will give us an easy fix.

scenes.summary: You must use the PAC to restore power for lowering and raising the bridge.

lines.text: The switch isn't working... It's out of juice.
We must reconnect it to an electrical grid — like the one provided by the PAC.

options: This feels like something we encountered back at the Hub Base.

lines.text: We now have a road to reach the Valley Pass.
Before we go, any intel on the Valley Pass?
Fiona, please update us on the latest situation.
Give me a moment. I'm sending you the algorithmic model.
I've rescued a number of civilians nearby. From what they told me, key leaders of the Bonekrushers might be active in this area.
There are also tracks even I do not recognize. Such as strange-looking flames illuminating the skies at night. They are using some power I am not familiar with.
Whatever they're up to, it's big. We better hurry.
